subject: Fix ZRANGE XX option schema and test failures under force-resp3 (#4275)
reason: The change only edits command JSON reply_schema metadata (compiled in solely under the LOG_REQ_RES CI build, absent from standard binaries) and fixes Tcl test assertions to accept the RESP3 null under --force-resp3. No C code changed; ZRANGE/ZRANGEBYSCORE/ZRANGEBYLEX and their REV variants with XX return the same replies (RESP2 *-1, RESP3 _) on both the parent and the change builds, so no fuzzer scenario can observe a difference or reach new behavior.
